title: Hidden Gems on Prime Video
intro: These are the films people stumble on at midnight and cannot stop thinking about by morning. Dark, precise and deeply human.

films.title: Calibre
films.line: A weekend hunting trip unravels into a suffocating moral nightmare you cannot escape.

films.title: The Disappeared
films.line: Grief and guilt blur into something genuinely unsettling in the dead of a London estate.

films.title: Housebound
films.line: Forced back to her childhood home, she starts to suspect the walls are hiding something alive.

films.title: Timecrimes
films.line: One ordinary afternoon spirals into a loop of paranoia and impossible choices.

films.title: A Simple Plan
films.line: Finding a bag of cash in the snow turns two brothers into people they barely recognise.

films.title: Pontypool
films.line: A late night radio host pieces together a catastrophe unfolding just beyond the studio door.

films.title: Coherence
films.line: One dinner party, one strange night, and reality quietly begins to splinter.

films.title: The Wailing
films.line: A fog rolls into a quiet village and something ancient and merciless follows it.

films.title: Frailty
films.line: A father receives a divine mission and pulls his sons into something they cannot escape.

films.title: Upgrade
films.line: A man given a second chance discovers the gift living inside him has its own agenda.

films.title: The Autopsy of Jane Doe
films.line: Every answer they uncover about her pulls them deeper into an unbearable darkness.

films.title: Prisoners
films.line: How far would you go to find your child when the answers keep shifting.

films.title: I Saw the Devil
films.line: Vengeance becomes a game between hunter and monster until the line disappears entirely.
